operations.summary: Create a site-bound HMAC-SHA256 URL authentication policy
operations.description: Requires url_auth_policies.manage. The generated key secret is returned exactly once on the first successful request. An identical idempotent replay returns the same policy with replayed=true and no secret. Third-party panel Type A, Type B, and MD5 are migration provenance only and cannot be selected for new execution. This endpoint records a deterministic edge-compatible snapshot but does not publish it to Gateway or an edge node.

responses.description: Policy, revision-one snapshot, and first-response-only key secret.

fields.description: Present only in the first successful create or rotate response. Never persisted in idempotency responses.
